text:
incident-bot: ALERT: canary rollout 'wave-3' (eu-west) showing sawtooth startup latency pattern and rising 5xx. rolling 10%->30% traffic. 5xx rate 0.8% -> 2.7% over 3m. Abort criteria (5xx > 2%) triggered.
anne: paging oncall — I'm on it, starting triage.
miguel: looking at runtime logs, seeing repeated timeouts during init. some pods show brief OOM spikes then recover. attaching snippet.
sre_jay: can we stop the rollout and shift traffic back? suggest kill-switch + rollback.
anne: initiating abort now. running abort command.
anne: ```opsctl rollout abort --wave wave-3 --reason "startup-latency-sawtooth"```
ops-bot: Rollout abort requested by anne. initiating traffic shift to baseline (wave-2). estimated shift complete ~45s.
kate_prod: any CS reports yet? customer-impact?
miguel: no direct CS tickets yet, but reserved tenant t-824 shows elevated 5xx and a few failed requests logged.
miguel: sample log snippet: ```2026-03-17T12:11:09Z runtime-45 ERROR handler.go:142 timeout on model init, kvcache warmup took 7.2s```
anne: observing 95p latency from 120ms -> 1.2s during pod cold starts, CPU spikes 3-4x. points to quantized startup stall.
sre_jay: temp mitigation: set kill flag for canaries and revert model sha.
anne: commands running: ```opsctl flag set KILL_CANARIES true && opsctl deploy revert --target wave-2 --sha f3a1c2```
ops-bot: Kill-switch enabled, starting revert to sha f3a1c2. Traffic shift in progress.
oncall-night: I'll take handoff in 20m, monitoring rollback completion and post-rollback health. ping me if 5xx > 0.5% or latency > 500ms.
anne: handoff notes: suspected root cause = startup CPU/KV-cache warmup race with quantized kernels causing transient stalls. short-term: rollback + kill-switch. follow-ups: extend readiness probe, add warmup caching, throttle concurrent inits. I'll file ticket.
miguel: created INF-2026: investigate quantized startup warmup, linked logs and perf traces.
incident-bot: Rollout abort completed at 1719997905. Traffic fully shifted back to wave-2. 5xx dropped to 0.4%, 95p latency back to ~150ms.
anne: thanks everyone. I'll coordinate the postmortem and mitigation plan. oncall-night, handing off monitoring.
oncall-night: ack, monitoring. ping if anything pops up.
